text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-controlled Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe police impounded over 300 vehicles in Harare over the weekend, arrested 28 people and issued more than 1,300 tickets for various traffic offences as they cracked down on reckless driving and defective vehicles.

- Diarrhoea has killed 107 people and afflicted another 58,209 countrywide in the past three months, prompting the ministry of health and child welfare to increase its educational campaigns against the disease.
